text:
mira: Heads-up — starting onboarding for zeta-13b-v1. HF source is https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-13b-v1 (weights under `pytorch_model-*`). I kicked off a mirror to s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/zeta-13b-v1/ earlier today. Can infra confirm checksum + read perms? Also saw tokenizer mismatch when loading locally (loader expects `tokenizer.json` but repo has `tokenizer.model`). PR created for model config tweaks: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/models/+/4523 @jasper @alex :wave:

jasper: grabbing the s3 copy now. quick note — HF manifest lists 8 shards but the S3 prefix has 9 files (one extra `.bin.part`), might be an interrupted upload. :thinking:

alex: @mira do you have the sha256 from HF? I can compare against S3 head-object. run: `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key models/zeta/zeta-13b-v1/pytorch_model-00001.bin` to check etag/size.

mira: HF manifest sha256 for archive: `3f8b9d2a9f7c6e4a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4` (copied from HF repo page). I also uploaded `manifest.json` to s3 at the same prefix.

sam: I saw the extra `.part` file in the mirror job logs — mirror job retried and left a stale partial. infra-bot should have cleaned it, but looks like the cleanup step failed on that run.

infra-bot: mirror-job-772 completed with warnings. Removed 3 stale temp objects but left `pytorch_model-00009.bin.part` flagged for manual review.

jasper: ok that explains it. I removed the `.part` object locally and re-downloaded shards. Doing `sha256sum` on concatenated shards now. If the hash matches HF manifest then we can mark artifact as green.

lin: tokenizer note — the model uses a SentencePiece `.model` file but our loader checks for `tokenizer.json` first. We should add fallback to SP model in the loader or push a converted json. Small patch in PR #4523 adds a `tokenizer_source` field to model config.

mira: pushing small config update now (adds `tokenizer_source: sentencepiece` and `expected_sha256` fields). Will also add a short README in the s3 prefix about canonical filenames so future mirrors don't miss them.

alex: quick perms check: I ran `aws s3api get-object-acl --bucket redwood-artifacts --key models/zeta/zeta-13b-v1/manifest.json` — ACL is private (owner full). But we rely on bucket policies/roles; ensure the model-registry role has `s3:GetObject` on that prefix. I filed a minimal IAM tweak in infra repo MR 119 to include `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/*` for the registry role.

mira: thanks. @jasper can you confirm checksum once `sha256sum` finishes? If green I'll add the `mirrored=true` tag in the registry and assign to QA for tokenizer smoke tests.

jasper: checksum result: `3f8b9d2a9f7c6e4a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4  zeta-13b-v1-concat.bin` — matches HF manifest. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: Added zeta-13b-v1 -> nightly-tokenizer-smoke test. Status: queued.

sam: small follow-up — can we add a CI check in the mirror pipeline that validates no trailing `.part` files and that `manifest.json` and `tokenizer.*` exist before marking a mirror complete? I'll open a ticket.

mira: yes please, that would have prevented this. Filing ticket now: https://tickets.redwood.dev/ML-788. Assigning to @sam and @alex for infra/CI bits.

alex: noted — I'll review MR 119 and the new CI ticket. Also pinging @infra-bot to re-run cleanup for `mirror-job-772` after MR lands.

infra-bot: scheduled cleanup for mirror-job-772 after IAM change is deployed.

mira: next steps for this thread: 1) infra to merge IAM tweak (alex), 2) CI/pipeline check for `.part` and manifest existence (sam), 3) merge model config PR with `tokenizer_source` (mira), 4) QA run and if pass mark artifact mirrored (jasper/qa-bot). Thanks all :raised_hands:

jasper: lgtm, will wait for QA and then tag artifact.

mira: closing loop — PR 4523 merged, IAM MR 119 merged, QA smoke passed this morning. I updated registry entry to `status: mirrored` and added note about tokenizer fallback. Thanks everyone! :tada:
